content.content:
We need list of movies that grossed over $700 million in 2023. Then get their directors. Then for each director, find when they directed their first movie (release year). Then sort directors by that year ascending.

We need data. Likely 2023 box office big hits: "Barbie" (~$1.4B), "The Super Mario Bros. Movie" (~$1.36B), "Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3" (~$845M), "Fast X" (~$720M), maybe "Oppenheimer" (~$945M?), actually Oppenheimer worldwide $945M. Also "Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse" ~ $600M not over 700. "The Little Mermaid" $560M. So list: Barbie, The Super Mario Bros. Movie, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3, Fast X, Oppenheimer. Also "Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania" only $476M. So five movies.

Directors: Barbie - Greta Gerwig. The Super Mario Bros. Movie - Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic (co-directors). Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 - James Gunn. Fast X - Louis Leterrier. Oppenheimer - Christopher Nolan.

We need directors (including co-directors). For each, first movie they directed (release year). Need to verify.

Greta Gerwig first directed "Lady Bird" (2017). Also co-wrote earlier but directed first feature: 2017.

Aaron Horvath: first directed? He is known for animated series, but first feature film director credit is "The Super Mario Bros. Movie" (2023) maybe also co-directed "Teen Titans Go! To the Movies"? Actually that was directed by Aaron Horvath? That film released 2018, directed by Aaron Horvath and Peter Rida Michail. So first movie directed: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies (2018). Michael Jelenic: co-directed same film; also directed "The Super Mario Bros. Movie". He also co-directed "Teen Titans Go! To the Movies" 2018. So first movie directed: Teen Titans Go! To the Movies (2018). So both have first movie 2018.

James Gunn first directed "Slither" (2006) co-writer? Actually his directorial debut was "Slither" (2006). So year 2006.

Louis Leterrier first directed "The Transporter" (2002) as co-director? Actually first solo director: "The Transporter" (2002). So 2002.

Christopher Nolan first directed "Following" (1998). So 1998.

Now sort by earliest first movie: Christopher Nolan (1998), James Gunn (2006), Louis Leterrier (2002) actually 2002 earlier than 2006, so order: Nolan 1998, Leterrier 2002, Gunn 2006, Greta Gerwig 2017, Aaron Horvath 2018, Michael Jelenic 2018.

But need sort earliest to most recent. So Nolan, Leterrier (2002), Gunn (2006), Gerwig (2017), Horvath (2018), Jelenic (2018). However Leterrier 2002 is earlier than Gunn 2006, correct.

We need to present director and first movie title with year. Also maybe note the movie they directed that grossed >$700M.

Provide citations? Use Wikipedia search tool. Need to fetch each director page for first movie. Let's search for each.
